parentChild.title: Parent-Child Communication
parentChild.subtitle: Parent→child: props vs defineProps; child→parent: callback vs custom emit.
parentChild.emptyText: No todos yet — child notifies parent via onAdd callback

defaultValue.title: Default value
defaultValue.vue: withDefaults(defineProps({ title: { type: String, default: '默认' } }), {})

propsModify.title: Modifying props
propsModify.antd: Immutable directly; parent changes state via a callback
propsModify.vue: Immutable directly; v-model:xxx is sugar for emit('update:xxx')

twoWay.title: Two-way binding
twoWay.subtitle: React: controlled (value + onChange); Vue: v-model sugar.

essence.title: Essence
essence.vue: one-way flow (props read-only + emit); v-model is sugar

provide.title: Cross-layer passing (Provide / Inject)
provide.subtitle: Avoid prop drilling: React uses createContext + Provider + useContext; Vue uses provide / inject + readonly.

injectPoint.title: Declare the injection point
injectPoint.vue: setup() top level: provide('key', value), or app.provide() at root

default.title: Default-value mechanism
default.vue: inject(key, default) — 2nd arg is the default

reactive.title: Reactivity
reactive.antd: Provider value ref changes (setState) → all consumers re-render
reactive.vue: pass ref/reactive to provide → inject auto-reacts

safe.title: Mutation safety
safe.antd: a Context value can be any structure; change only via callbacks

ref.title: Ref / DOM operations
ref.subtitle: React: useRef + forwardRef + useImperativeHandle; Vue: ref="x" + defineExpose.
ref.logEmpty: Log area below: click right buttons to auto-scroll to bottom (scrollBox.current.scrollTo)
ref.domRefCard: ① DOM Ref: native input / div
ref.imperativeCard: ② forwardRef + useImperativeHandle: imperative component API
ref.imperativeNote1: The parent cannot read child internal state directly; it must go through
ref.imperativeNote2: explicitly exposing methods. One-to-one with Vue 3’s

domRef.title: DOM ref declaration
domRef.vue: const r = ref(null); <input ref="r" /> (same name binds)

crossRef.title: Passing ref across components
crossRef.vue: child ref defaults to root DOM; or $refs (options API)

readWrite.title: Reading / writing ref values
readWrite.antd: read/write r.current; changing .current does not render

multiRef.title: Multiple refs: lists
multiRef.antd: ref={el => arr[i] = el} (callback ref) or useRef([])

sideEffect.title: "Side-effect" DOM operations
sideEffect.antd: operate in useEffect (after mount / deps change)

slot.title: Slots / Children distribution
slot.subtitle: React: children / ReactNode props / renderItem; Vue: default / named / scoped slot.
slot.todayText: Today is a great day. The child renders this whole block via props.children.
slot.namedSlot: ② Named slots: ReactNode props (title / extra / footer / children)

named.title: Named slots
named.antd: multiple props: title / header / footer all ReactNode

fallback.title: Fallback content
fallback.antd: in the container: children || default node

multiSlot.title: Multiple slots + data
multiSlot.antd: each slot prop takes (scope) => ReactNode (function slots)

scenario.title: Use cases
scenario.antd: generic Card / Modal / Table column / List itemRender

state.title: Global state sharing
state.subtitle: React: createContext + useReducer/useMemo store; Vue: reactive + provide/inject or Pinia. Native-only, no Redux/Zustand/Pinia.

native.title: Approach (native)
native.antd: createContext + Provider + useContext; state in Provider
native.vue: reactive/ref object + provide(key, store); or Pinia (official store)

reference.title: State reference
reference.antd: Provider value is new each setState; ref change re-renders all consumers
reference.vue: reactive ref is stable; mutating a property triggers only its subscribers

perf.title: Performance optimization
perf.antd: split Contexts / memo + useCallback / useMemo / selectors
perf.vue: computed caches automatically; precise component granularity

async.title: Async updates
async.vue: an action is a plain async function mutating reactive props

devtools.title: Devtools
devtools.antd: React DevTools Components for Context; Redux/Zustand have panels
devtools.vue: Vue DevTools → Pinia panel or Setup state tree
